questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: If the length of a simple pendulum is made four times its original value, its time period becomes:
questions.explanation: T = 2π√(l/g), so T is proportional to √l. Making l four times larger doubles the time period.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: For an ideal gas undergoing an isothermal expansion, the change in internal energy is:
questions.explanation: Internal energy of an ideal gas depends only on temperature. In an isothermal process T is constant, so ΔU = 0 and all the heat supplied appears as work.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The electric field at any point inside a charged hollow conducting sphere is:
questions.explanation: By Gauss's law the enclosed charge is zero for any Gaussian surface inside the shell, so E = 0 everywhere inside, although the potential is constant and non-zero.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 12, Chapter 1: Electric Charges and Fields

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In a galvanic cell, oxidation takes place at the:
questions.explanation: Oxidation always occurs at the anode. In a galvanic cell the anode is the negative electrode because electrons are released there.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
questions.question: The correct order of atomic radii among the second period elements is:
questions.explanation: Across a period the nuclear charge rises while the shell stays the same, so atomic radius decreases from left to right.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 3: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which reagent is used to distinguish phenol from ethanol?
questions.explanation: Phenol gives a violet colour with neutral ferric chloride because of a coloured iron-phenoxide complex, while ethanol gives no colour.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 7: Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Bryophytes are called the amphibians of the plant kingdom because they:
options: Live on land but need water for fertilisation
questions.explanation: Bryophytes grow in damp soil but their flagellated antherozoids need a film of water to swim to the archegonium.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Crossing over between non-sister chromatids of homologous chromosomes occurs during which sub-stage of prophase I?
questions.explanation: Pachytene is marked by the appearance of recombination nodules where crossing over takes place, catalysed by recombinase.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 10: Cell Cycle and Cell Division

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Maximum reabsorption of the glomerular filtrate takes place in the:
questions.explanation: Nearly 70-80 percent of electrolytes and water are reabsorbed in the PCT, which is lined by brush-border cuboidal epithelium.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 16: Excretory Products and their Elimination

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Saltatory conduction of a nerve impulse, in which the impulse jumps from one node of Ranvier to the next, occurs in:
questions.explanation: Myelin insulates the axon except at the nodes of Ranvier, so depolarisation jumps node to node and conduction is much faster.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 18: Neural Control and Coordination
